programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u012/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    """Connect aligned marker cells by drawing color 3 between them."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    markers = {(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != background}
    by_row = {}
    by_col = {}
    for r, c in markers:
        by_row.setdefault(r, []).append(c)
        by_col.setdefault(c, []).append(r)
    for r, cols in by_row.items():
        for c in range(min(cols) + 1, max(cols)):
            if (r, c) not in markers:
                out[r][c] = 3
    for c, rows in by_col.items():
        for r in range(min(rows) + 1, max(rows)):
            if (r, c) not in markers:
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
